name: Yūshi Naishinnō-ke no Kii
bio: Poet of the Hyakunin Isshu (no. 72); Porter’s note gives the dates as: fl. 1087–1107.

poems.title: The sound of ripples on the shore
poems.author: Yūshi Naishinnō-ke no Kii
poems.collection: A Hundred Verses from Old Japan (Hyakunin Isshu), poem 72
poems.text:
The sound of ripples on the shore
Ne’er fails at Takashi;
My sleeves all worn and wet with tears
Should surely prove to thee,
I, too, will constant be.
